usedFor: Lightspeed Retail POS (X-Series) holds sales and customers, and HubSpot opens a deal with “Create Deal” when “Customer Changes”.

bestTemplate.name: “Customer Changes” in Lightspeed Retail POS (X-Series), then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A changed customer record can start a deal in HubSpot, so sales sees retail activity.

watchOut: “Customer Changes” runs on any change, so the same customer can run “Create Deal” more than once.
